method: Codex session agents; fresh context, anonymous source packets only
method_deviation: Sonnet API credits exhausted after 8 questions; separate complete review, no mixing of graders
token_usage_note: Session-review token counts and provider model identifiers were not exported.
limitations: Exploratory Codex-session review; differs from the predeclared Sonnet judge. Two fresh-context agents each reviewed 20 paired questions using anonymous packets; they did not duplicate every judgment. The coordinator sees model identities. Exact provider model identity, decoding, and token usage are unavailable. QASPER references were not independently validated; packets contain one canonical answer and annotated evidence rather than all annotations/full papers. Model judgments may be wrong. This is not human review or a promotion result.
